phase_19_monolithic_qelu_geometry_mining.result_summary: 4-, 8-, 16-, and 32-bit QELU layouts corresponding to 12, 24, 48, and 96 physical qubits executed as monolithic circuit blocks.
phase_19_monolithic_qelu_geometry_mining.interpretation: Monolithic construction/transpilation/execution feasibility and containment classification.
phase_19_monolithic_qelu_geometry_mining.caveat: Original containment metric was permissive; not exact logical word recovery.

phase_21_qelu_v6_advanced_analytics.interpretation: Locally robust but globally decoder-limited; failure mode is synchronization/reconstruction rather than local collapse.

phase_22_cross_backend_baseline_advantag.interpretation: Backend-replicated resonant baseline advantage in selected theta-depth regimes.
phase_22_cross_backend_baseline_advantag.caveat: Simulator resistance, new physics, and Born-rule violation remain unproven because hardware-vs-ideal TVD did not populate.
